row.notes: Constructor, not a hash map (old note wrong): this[0]=vt 0x14589efa0, copies 20 qwords of the desc; for 8 slots desc[3..10] (and depth desc[0x13]) packs format byte tex+0x20 (0x56->0x0f) and sample mask 1<<[tex+0x28]+0x3c into a 0x48-byte key, count at +0xb0; MD5 (Ne_Hash_Md5Transform/Finalize) of the key, first 8 bytes byte-swapped to +0xa8. call sites, e.g. Game_DrlGenerator_CreateGpuResources.
